15–30 min per day during the event

Every October, the Combined Magical Winterberry Society asks players to collect {item:Bunch of Winterberries|Bunches of Winterberries} and stomp them in a vat to make the magical juice used in potions. It is a world quest: if the server stomps 40 loads (4,000 bunches), {wiki:Health Potions|Health Potions} and {wiki:Mana Potions|Mana Potions} become 33% stronger for 7 days. Taking part for 3 years gives the achievement **Berry Picker**.

There are winterberries all over Tibia now! The Combined Magical Winterberry Society wants YOU to help pick them and, of course, process them to create the juice that keeps the world's magic flowing. Happy stomping!
Emilie, west of Thais' north gate
The event runs from **1 to 8 October** and from **17 to 24 October** (plus 7 days of rewards).
You need to have at least **3** {item:Bunch of Winterberries|Bunches of Winterberries} with you for Emilie to let you in.
per character every 24 hours (minimum 3 to enter)
to carry water to the vat
If the world completes the event: effect of {wiki:Health Potions|Health Potions} and {wiki:Mana Potions|Mana Potions} increased by 33% for 7 days
Bunches of winterberries drop from various creatures during the event: hunt as usual and keep them.
Bring an empty {item:Bucket}: you will need it when the vat asks for water.
The stomping phase needs several people at the same time. Go when there are people in the cellar.
You can ask Emilie or Gruffy for {key:status} to find out how many charges your world has processed so far.

Go to **Thais** and talk to {npc:Emilie}, just **west of the north gate**. With at least 3 bunches of winterberries in your inventory, say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. She teleports you to the Winterberry Cellar.
If you don't have at least 3 bunches, she won't let you in.
{npc:Gruffy} is in the cellar. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} for him to explain the event to you.
The event has several stages that repeat. Orange messages on screen tell you what is needed at each moment. When all the phases are over, the next stage begins or the event ends successfully.
Phase 1: put the berries in the moulds

Go to the far **north** of the cellar and use a {item:Bunch of Winterberries} on one of the {item:Mould|moulds}. *"Squish!"* appears. Each character can hand in **10 bunches per day**; when you reach the limit, *"You already delivered all of your winterberries for today."* appears. **100** bunches are needed in total to move on to the next phase.
Using the winterberries on the moulds

Get into the vat and walk over the {item:Winterberries}. Each square gets smoother as you step on it, but if nobody steps on it for a while it goes back to an earlier state. That is why **several people** are needed, stepping at the same time.
Players stomping the berries in the vat
The states of the stomped berries
When sugar is requested, go to the **east** side of the vat, where the sugar area is. Use the sugar (right-click → Use) and then use it on the vat.
Sugar area, east of the vat
When water is requested, go to the **west** side of the vat, where the fountains are. Use the {item:Bucket} on the fountains and then use the bucket on the vat.
Water fountains, west of the vat
When {creature:Berrypest|Berrypests} appear in the vat, kill them all before they eat the berries. While there are pests, you can't keep stomping.

After these phases, an orange message may ask for more berries: repeat phases 1 to 3. It is not known how many times this repeats, but at the end a message appears saying the event has finished. The event succeeds as soon as the world stomps **40 charges (4,000 bunches)**.
The **berry vat** at the far north of the cellar shows what stage they are at: at the end it should look like the last state of the {item:Pressed Winterberries}.
Last state of the stomped berries
To leave the cellar, say to {npc:Gruffy} {key:hi}, {key:Thais} (or {key:transport}) and {key:yes}.

If your world completes the event, Health Potions and Mana Potions become **33% stronger for 7 days**. If you contribute at least one {item:Bunch of Winterberries} in one of the events each year, for **3 years**, you receive the achievement **Berry Picker**.
